step1.description:
React has been around for over 10 years. That's forever in frontend terms. So is it just antiquated at this point?

I'm very excited to welcome React Core Team member Ricky Hanlon on to talk all things React. We will dig into the innovations the team has been making in the space, especially around scheduling and concurrenccy, and talk about where things are going for React and frontend in general.
